raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

With `--tokenizer-worker-num N` the HTTP server runs N uvicorn workers that all accept from one shared listening socket. Linux does not round-robin a shared accept queue: whichever workers wake first take the connections, so a burst can land mostly on one worker. A long-lived connection (a streaming response, a WebSocket session) then stays on that worker for its whole life, so the imbalance persists and the busy worker's event loop adds latency to every request it holds.

## Modifications

- `python/sglang/srt/arg_groups/fields/serving.py`: new opt-in `--enable-http-worker-reuseport` (default off). With it set, every uvicorn worker owns a private `SO_REUSEPORT` listener on the configured host and port, so the kernel spreads new connections across the reuseport group instead of one shared accept queue. Default off keeps uvicorn's standard shared listener; nothing changes for existing deployments.
- `python/sglang/srt/entrypoints/http_server.py`: `_ReusePortMultiprocess`, a subclass of uvicorn's `Multiprocess` supervisor. uvicorn reads `self.sockets` once for every worker it spawns (at start, after a health-check failure, on `SIGHUP` restart, on `SIGTTIN`), so the subclass hands out a fresh private listener on each read and closes the parent's copy once the child holds it; the lifecycle itself (health checks, ready-wait on restart, start-up-failure handling) stays uvicorn's own. A spawn that fails part-way at start-up terminates the workers already started. Start-up still fails fast on a port that is already in use: before the first reuseport bind the supervisor probes the address once without `SO_REUSEPORT`, under a per-port lock (an abstract Unix socket name), so two servers started at the same time on one fixed `host:port` cannot both come up; `--port 0` keeps picking an ephemeral port. An unresolvable host exits with the error logged, as the plain uvicorn path does. The non-reuseport branch is the existing `uvicorn.run` call with the same options.
- `python/sglang/srt/arg_groups/serving_hook.py`: the flag is rejected with a single tokenizer worker (nothing to balance) and with `--enable-http2`, whose server does not run under the uvicorn supervisor.
- `python/sglang/srt/arg_groups/field_order.py`: the new field is appended to `POSITIONAL_FIELD_ORDER` so `test_builtin_fields_have_explicit_positional_slots` stays green.
- `python/pyproject.toml`: `uvicorn>=0.51`, the release in which `Process` and `Multiprocess` dropped their `target` argument and `Process` started building its own `Server`; the subclass relies on that shape.
- `docs/docs/advanced_features/server_arguments.mdx`: the row for the new flag that `test_server_args_docs_coverage.py` requires.
- `test/registered/unit/entrypoints/test_http_server_reuseport.py` (new, `base-a-test-cpu`): each worker gets its own `SO_REUSEPORT` listener and the parent's copy is closed after the hand-off, the address is resolved once, a replaced, restarted or `SIGTTIN`-added worker gets a fresh listener and the old one is closed; a spawn that fails part-way terminates and joins the workers already started; an unresolvable host exits cleanly with the error logged; two supervisors racing for the same fixed `host:port` admit exactly one, two with `--port 0` both start, and two on different addresses both start; a real uvicorn worker process serves a request on the listener it was handed.
- `test/registered/unit/server_args/test_server_args.py`, `test/registered/unit/test_server_args_cli_metadata.py`: the flag is rejected with one worker and with HTTP/2, accepted with several workers, and is off unless given on the command line.

`SO_REUSEPORT` load balancing and the abstract socket namespace used for the lock are Linux semantics, which is why the behaviour is opt-in.

## Accuracy Tests

Not applicable: no change to scheduling, model execution or outputs.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

With the flag unset the only addition is one boolean check before `uvicorn.run`. With the flag set, each worker accepts from its own `SO_REUSEPORT` listener, so new connections are distributed by the kernel across the reuseport group rather than taken from one shared accept queue by whichever worker wakes first. No benchmark numbers are included here; the effect on connection placement and latency depends on the workload and is best measured with a synthetic burst of long-lived streaming connections against several tokenizer workers.

On this head, with uvicorn 0.54.0 (what CI installs): `pytest test/registered/unit/entrypoints/test_http_server_reuseport.py` passes (7 tests), also when the file is run directly as `run_suite.py` does; `test_server_args_docs_coverage.py` passes; `test/registered/unit/server_args/test_server_args.py` and `test/registered/unit/test_server_args_cli_metadata.py` pass apart from `TestDcpCommBackendDefault::test_a5_npu_supports_dcp`, which fails identically on `main` on the same host. `pre-commit run` on the nine files passes.

## Checklist

- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

+class _ReusePortMultiprocess(Multiprocess):
+    """Give each uvicorn worker a private SO_REUSEPORT listener.
+
+    uvicorn's supervisor reads ``self.sockets`` once per worker it spawns, so a
+    fresh listener is handed out on every read and the parent's copy is closed
+    once the child holds it; the lifecycle (health checks, restarts, SIGTTIN)
+    stays uvicorn's own. Requires uvicorn >= 0.51, whose Process builds its
+    own Server.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, config: uvicorn.Config):
+        self._handed_out: List[socket.socket] = []
+        self._reserved_socket: Optional[socket.socket] = _reserve_reuseport_socket(
+            config
+        )
+        self._socket_family = self._reserved_socket.family
+        self._socket_address = self._reserved_socket.getsockname()
+        super().__init__(config, sockets=[])
+
+    @property
+    def sockets(self) -> List[socket.socket]:
+        self._close_handed_out()
+        sock = self._reserved_socket
+        self._reserved_socket = None
+        if sock is None:
+            sock = _bind_reuseport_socket(
+                self.config, self._socket_family, self._socket_address
+            )
+        self._handed_out.append(sock)
+        return [sock]
+
+    @sockets.setter
+    def sockets(self, value: List[socket.socket]) -> None:
+        if value:
+            raise ValueError("_ReusePortMultiprocess binds its own listeners")
+
+    def _close_handed_out(self) -> None:
+        # Each spawn site starts its Process before the next read, so every
+        # listener handed out so far is already held by its child.
+        for sock in self._handed_out:
+            sock.close()
+        self._handed_out.clear()
+
+    def init_processes(self) -> None:
+        try:
+            super().init_processes()
+        except BaseException:
+            self.terminate_all()
+            self.join_all()
+            raise
+        finally:
+            self._close_handed_out()
+
+    def restart_all(self) -> None:
+        try:
+            super().restart_all()
+        finally:
+            self._close_handed_out()
+
+    def keep_subprocess_alive(self) -> None:
+        try:
+            super().keep_subprocess_alive()
+        finally:
+            self._close_handed_out()
+
+    def handle_ttin(self) -> None:
+        try:
+            super().handle_ttin()
+        finally:
+            self._close_handed_out()
+
+
+def _bind_reuseport_socket(config: uvicorn.Config, family, address) -> socket.socket:
+    sock = socket.socket(family=family)
+    sock.setsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET, socket.SO_REUSEADDR, 1)
+    sock.setsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET, socket.SO_REUSEPORT, 1)
+    sock.bind(address)
+    sock.listen(config.backlog)
+    sock.set_inheritable(True)
+    return sock
+
+
+def _reserve_reuseport_socket(config: uvicorn.Config) -> socket.socket:
+    try:
+        family = socket.AF_INET6 if ":" in config.host else socket.AF_INET
+        address = socket.getaddrinfo(config.host, config.port, family)[0][4]
+        if config.port == 0:
+            sock = _bind_reuseport_socket(config, family, address)
+            config.port = sock.getsockname()[1]
+            return sock
+        name = f"\0sglang-reuseport-{os.geteuid()}-{config.port}"
+        with socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX) as reservation:
+            while True:
+                try:
+                    reservation.bind(name)
+                    break
+                except OSError as error:
+                    if error.errno != errno.EADDRINUSE:
+                        raise
+                    time.sleep(0.01)
+            with socket.socket(family=family) as probe:
+                probe.setsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET, socket.SO_REUSEADDR, 1)
+                probe.bind(address)
+            return _bind_reuseport_socket(config, family, address)
+    except OSError as error:
+        logger.error(error)
+        raise SystemExit(1) from error

+"""With --enable-http-worker-reuseport every uvicorn worker must own a private
+SO_REUSEPORT listener on the configured address, a replaced worker must get a
+fresh one, and a second server on the same fixed host:port must still fail to
+start instead of silently joining the first server's reuseport group.
+"""
+
+import copy
+import signal
+import socket
+import sys
+import threading
+from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
+from contextlib import suppress
+from unittest.mock import Mock
+
+import pytest
+import uvicorn
+from uvicorn.supervisors import multiprocess
+from uvicorn.supervisors.multiprocess import SIGNALS
+
+from sglang.srt.entrypoints import http_server
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=2, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+
+@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
+def restore_signal_handlers():
+    # Multiprocess.__init__ replaces process-wide signal handlers.
+    handlers = {sig: signal.getsignal(sig) for sig in SIGNALS}
+    yield
+    for sig, handler in handlers.items():
+        signal.signal(sig, handler)
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def config(free_tcp_port):
+    return uvicorn.Config(
+        "starlette.applications:Starlette",
+        host="127.0.0.1",
+        port=free_tcp_port,
+        workers=4,
+        factory=True,
+        lifespan="off",
+        log_level="error",
+    )
+
+
+def _start(config, monkeypatch):
+    children = []
+
+    class FakeProcess:
+        # The uvicorn supervisor spawns through the module-level Process name.
+        def __init__(self, _config, sockets):
+            self.sockets = sockets
+            self.alive = True
+            self.exitcode = None
+            self.pid = len(children) + 1
+
+        def start(self):
+            self.listener = self.sockets[0].dup()
+            children.append(self.listener)
+
+        def is_alive(self, timeout):
+            return self.alive
+
+        def wait_until_ready(self, timeout, should_exit=None):
+            return True
+
+        def kill(self):
+            self.alive = False
+            self.listener.close()
+
+        terminate = kill
+
+        def join(self):
+            return None
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(multiprocess, "Process", FakeProcess)
+    supervisor = http_server._ReusePortMultiprocess(config)
+    supervisor.init_processes()
+    return supervisor, children
+
+
+def test_worker_listener_lifecycle(monkeypatch, config):
+    resolve = Mock(wraps=socket.getaddrinfo)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(socket, "getaddrinfo", resolve)
+    supervisor, children = _start(config, monkeypatch)
+    assert resolve.call_count == 1
+    try:
+        assert all(p.sockets[0].fileno() == -1 for p in supervisor.processes)
+        assert len({sock.fileno() for sock in children}) == config.workers
+        assert all(
+            sock.getsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET, socket.SO_REUSEPORT) for sock in children
+        )
+
+        old = supervisor.processes[0]
+        old.alive = False
+        supervisor.keep_subprocess_alive()
+        new = supervisor.processes[0]
+        assert new is not old and old.listener.fileno() == -1
+        assert new.sockets[0].fileno() == -1 and new.listener.fileno() != -1
+
+        before_restart = list(supervisor.processes)
+        supervisor.restart_all()
+        assert all(process.listener.fileno() == -1 for process in before_restart)
+        assert all(p.sockets[0].fileno() == -1 for p in supervisor.processes)
+
+        supervisor.handle_ttin()
+        assert len(supervisor.processes) == config.workers + 1
+        assert supervisor.processes[-1].sockets[0].fileno() == -1
+    finally:
+        for sock in children:
+            sock.close()
+
+
+def test_partial_spawn_failure_cleans_up_workers(monkeypatch, config):
+    config.workers = 3
+    workers = [Mock(), Mock()]
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        multiprocess, "Process", Mock(side_effect=[*workers, RuntimeError("failed")])
+    )
+    supervisor = http_server._ReusePortMultiprocess(config)
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError):
+        supervisor.init_processes()
+    for worker in workers:
+        worker.terminate.assert_called_once()
+        worker.join.assert_called_once()
+    assert supervisor._reserved_socket is None and not supervisor._handed_out
+
+
+def test_unresolvable_host_exits_cleanly(monkeypatch, caplog, config):
+    resolve = Mock(side_effect=socket.gaierror("bad host"))
+    monkeypatch.setattr(socket, "getaddrinfo", resolve)
+    with pytest.raises(SystemExit):
+        http_server._ReusePortMultiprocess(config)
+    assert "bad host" in caplog.text
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("hosts", "ephemeral", "expected_winners"),
+    [
+        (("127.0.0.1",) * 2, False, 1),
+        (("127.0.0.1",) * 2, True, 2),
+        (("127.0.0.1", "127.0.0.2"), False, 2),
+    ],
+)
+def test_concurrent_supervisor_reservation(
+    monkeypatch, config, hosts, ephemeral, expected_winners
+):
+    barrier = threading.Barrier(2)
+    bind = http_server._bind_reuseport_socket
+
+    def synchronized_bind(*args):
+        with suppress(threading.BrokenBarrierError):
+            barrier.wait(timeout=1)
+        return bind(*args)
+
+    def create_supervisor(index):
+        worker_config = copy.copy(config)
+        worker_config.host = hosts[index]
+        worker_config.port = 0 if ephemeral else config.port
+        try:
+            return http_server._ReusePortMultiprocess(worker_config)
+        except SystemExit:
+            return None
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(http_server.Multiprocess, "__init__", Mock(return_value=None))
+    monkeypatch.setattr(http_server, "_bind_reuseport_socket", synchronized_bind)
+    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) as pool:
+        supervisors = list(pool.map(create_supervisor, range(2)))
+
+    winners = [supervisor for supervisor in supervisors if supervisor is not None]
+    for supervisor in winners:
+        supervisor._reserved_socket.close()
+    assert len(winners) == expected_winners
+
+
+def test_real_uvicorn_worker_accepts_on_private_listener(config):
+    config.workers = 1
+    supervisor = http_server._ReusePortMultiprocess(config)
+    supervisor.init_processes()
+    try:
+        assert supervisor._reserved_socket is None and not supervisor._handed_out
+        # The listener accepts at once; the reply waits for the spawned worker,
+        # which re-imports this module and its server imports before serving.
+        with socket.create_connection(
+            (config.host, config.port), timeout=120
+        ) as connection:
+            connection.sendall(b"GET /openapi.json HTTP/1.0\r\n\r\n")
+            assert b"404 Not Found" in connection.recv(1024)
+    finally:
+        supervisor.terminate_all()
+        supervisor.join_all()
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(pytest.main([__file__, "-v"]))
